name: Cancel Workflow Action
description: This Action will cancel any previous runs that are not `completed` for a given workflow.

workflow_id.description: Optional - A single Workflow ID or a comma separated list of IDs

ignore_sha.description: Optional - Allow canceling other workflows with the same SHA. Useful for the `pull_request.closed` event.

access_token.description: Your GitHub Access Token, defaults to: {{ github.token }}

all_but_latest.description: Optional - Cancel all actions but the most recent one.

only_status.description: Optional - Cancel runs with a specific status, such as `waiting`.
